title: One-time Specialized Academic Council PhD (Podolska O.A.)

blocks.content: Educational and Scientific Program: Materials Science and Metal Processing
Scientific Supervisor: Director of the Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher Hanna KONONENKO
Dissertation Topic: Patterns of the influence of structural inhomogeneity and hot plastic deformation of hypoeutectoid steel on the reliability of railway axles
Order No.__ dated 27.07.2026 'On the Establishment of a One-time Specialized Academic Council for Awarding the Degree of Doctor of Philosophy'

Chairman of the One-time Council – Parusov Eduard Volodymyrovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Acting Deputy Director for Scientific Work of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.

Official Opponent – Fedoriachenko Serhii Oleksandrovych, Candidate of Technical Sciences, Associate Professor, Vice-Rector for Scientific-Pedagogical, Educational and Prospective Development Work of the Dnipro University of Technology of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine.

Official Opponent — Volchuk Volodymyr Mykolaiovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Head of the Department of Materials Science and Materials Processing of the Prydniprovska State Academy of Civil Engineering and Architecture of the Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine.

Reviewer – Chuiko Ihor Mykolaiovych, Candidate of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Senior Researcher of the Department of Heat Treatment of Metal for Mechanical Engineering of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.

Reviewer – Baranovska Olena Yevhenivna, Candidate of Technical Sciences, Researcher of the Department of Heat Treatment of Metal for Mechanical Engineering of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.
Date and Time of Defense: April 1, 2025, starting at 10:00.
Place of Defense: Dnipro, Academician Starodubov Square, 1, Room 314.
